# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/463-17/1_463-17_init.xlsx'

        continue

# or just create a new series for column D.
df['Required link this'] = pd.Series(expanded_list)

df.to_excel(output_path, index=False)
